planning_notes: Board is arduino:avr:uno; wiring preserved: D7->DHT11 temperature sensor, D4/D5->TM1637 CLK/DIO, per authoritative pin assignments.
TM1637 refresh cadence (every 2 seconds) is business/model timing; control_period_ms is scheduling granularity only. Device requests do not encode display refresh intervals.
DHT11 sampling period is set to 2000ms to match the requirement '每 2 秒刷新' and to satisfy the catalog constraint sample_period_ms >= 2000.
No serial reporting requirements were provided; serial_channels is empty.
No pin overrides were supplied; therefore no additional pin configuration is included.
